terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Club-style outdoor armchair: splayed + reclined teak box frame on a circular swivel ring, open diagonal rope lattice in the rear and both lateral frames, two loose cushions. Bilaterally symmetric about X=0; the set photo shows a mirrored pair, i.e. two rear 3/4 azimuths.

reasoning: Repetition density drives the tier: the lateral and rear lattices hold several hundred rope crossings, and their over/under interlacing and see-through openings are identity-defining.
Structure is a compound hard-surface assembly (~11 teak members) whose splay and recline must be preserved from two rear 3/4 azimuths.
Three distinct PBR responses (satin wood, matte braided rope, matte slub fabric) plus local overrides (rail-top sheen, grain, braid relief, flecks).
Swivel rotation and a 4-group exploded view are required by the intended /capabilities use.

specDepthDecision.rationale: complex: deep enough for per-member teak frame parts, three procedural weave panels with interlaced strands, cushions and a swivel base, each tagged to an explode group.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Diamond openings between diagonal rope strands on the lateral panel; cushion and background visible through them.
Strands alternate over/under at each crossing, producing raised crowns and shadowed dips.

Rear panel uses a DIFFERENT motif from the sides (zone r1c1 close-up): stacked rows of V-shaped rope loops (chevron/fish-scale) with small crescent openings. Modelled as a denser interlaced lattice - a documented approximation.
Each rope strand shows a braided/twisted helical relief with lighter crowns.
Armrest top edge dips slightly mid-length and overhangs the lateral panel outward.

Close-up zone r0c2: the lateral frame (its rear post + armrest) sits OUTSIDE the rear frame, so the armrest's round-ended rear stub protrudes behind the rear panel. Earlier read as a top-rail 'ear' - corrected.
Rear top rail meets the rear stiles with a large outer corner radius.
Every teak rail and post has softly eased edges catching a thin highlight.
Satin sheen band on upward-facing teak surfaces (rail tops, armrest tops).
Straight longitudinal grain lines along every member, slightly darker than the base honey tone.
Small round fastener caps on the lateral rear post: one at the armrest joint and one at the bottom-rail joint (zone r2c1), per side - 4 in total.
Sparse darker slub flecks in the light beige cushion weave.
Boxed cushion edge seam along the back cushion perimeter.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: HIDDEN front-face (conf 0.40): seat front edge, front posts' inner faces and a possible front apron rail are not visible in either view; inferred from class convention.
HIDDEN swivel-mechanism (conf 0.35): swivel plate and stretcher-to-plate joint under the seat box; inferred as a disc on crossed stretchers.
UNCERTAIN recline-splay-angles (conf 0.55): recline ~12 deg and splay ~6 deg estimated from perspective views, not an elevation.
UNCERTAIN rear-weave-motif (conf 0.50): rear panel is stacked chevron rope loops (zone r1c1); modelled as a denser interlaced lattice.
OCCLUDED armrest-front-termination (conf 0.55): only the far armrest front end is partly visible; square end with small forward overhang assumed.

definitionOfDone: From both rear 3/4 azimuths the render reads as this chair: splayed + reclined teak box on a visible round swivel ring, back cushion rising above the rear rail.
Lateral panels show see-through diamond openings with over/under interlaced rope, not a solid or textured slab.
Rear panel lattice is visibly denser than the lateral lattice.
Teak reads satin honey-brown with longitudinal grain; rope reads matte mid-dark brown; cushions read matte light beige.
Upper assembly swivels about Y and the model separates into base / frame / weave / cushion explode groups.

featureGroups.name: Splayed, reclined seat box on a swivel ring
qualityCriteria: Top footprint wider than bottom by the splay; rear panel reclined; back cushion crown above the rear rail by ~0.14 m; ring visible below with a gap under the box.
failureModes: box reads as an upright cube
base reads as a solid pedestal instead of an open ring

featureGroups.name: Teak frame members
qualityCriteria: Separate posts, bottom rails, rear top rail with ears and two armrests; joints meet without gaps or floating members.
failureModes: posts not following splay/recline so panels gap at the corners

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every member, weave panel and cushion declares parent socket, local start/end, contact type and gap tolerance; weave strand ends are embedded in the frame.
failureModes: cushions intersect the frame or hover above the deck

featureGroups.name: Interlaced rope lattice
qualityCriteria: Diagonal strands at +/-45 deg, perpendicular pitch ~0.056 m lateral / ~0.042 m rear, strand diameter ~0.023 m, alternating over/under offsets at crossings, openings see-through.
failureModes: panel rendered as a solid slab or flat alpha card
pitch so tight the openings vanish

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Independent albedo/roughness/normal per material; satin sheen on teak upward faces; braid relief on rope; slub flecks on cushions.

featureGroups.name: Reference color and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Studio white-background lighting: soft key from upper front-left, low-contrast fill, soft contact shadow; palette sampled from reference pixels.
failureModes: harsh single light with black shadows

visualDeltaChecks: splay/recline silhouette delta from both rear 3/4 azimuths
lattice opening size and pitch delta on the lateral panel
rear vs lateral lattice density ratio
back cushion crown height above the rear rail
teak / rope / cushion albedo and roughness delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

mustMatch: reference-derived PBR material response at or above 0.7 confidence when source pixels are usable
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Splayed + reclined seat box on an open swivel ring
Teak frame members meet at joints with splay and recline
Back cushion rises above the rear rail
Satin teak / matte rope / matte beige fabric

nextRequiredEvidence: Quality contract has named all required macro feature groups before code generation.
browser render screenshot from your agent's browser/screenshot tool
side-by-side reference/render comparison sheet for AI vision review
banded interior difference vs the reference baseline (forge/stage4_review/interior_difference.py --from/--to per region)
AI vision score at or above the visual acceptance threshold
all critical semantic feature scores from the shared image pair at or above their thresholds
self-correction review appended with action=continue before the next pass

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout iter1: structure reads as the chair (splay, recline, lateral frame outside rear frame, armrest rear stub, 4 fastener caps, interlaced lattice) but Tier1 fails (IoU 0.536 vs isolated reference) on four spec-level defects.
matched: lateral frame sits outside rear frame with protruding armrest stub (d06)
fastener caps upper+lower at rear posts (d10)
interlaced over/under lattice with see-through openings (d01,d02)
back cushion crown above rear rail
mismatches: back cushion reads as a faceted dome and seat cushion as a lens: primitive family wrong (box cage 1x1x1 + Catmull-Clark x2 collapses to a blob)
seat box bottom at y=0.08 hides the swivel ring: reference shows ~0.09 m clear gap between box bottom and ring top, measured at front-left where both sit at similar depth
lattice turnaround loops overshoot ~20-30 mm and poke through the armrest top (row of rope bumps along the armrest)
reference PBR maps referenced by bare filename -> 404 in browser -> white albedo + roughness 0 -> chrome look (textured render only
teak registry profile should be wood.unfinished (satin oiled outdoor teak) not wood.varnished
specFixes: cushions: topologyClass implicit, SDF box core smooth-union ellipsoid crown
raise Y0 0.08->0.14 and swivel plate to match the measured gap
lattice: embed 0.012->0.004 and insert an outward turnaround control point 8 mm beyond the panel edge
serve reference maps from frontend/public and set referencePbr.maps.*.url

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout iter2: cushions, swivel gap and reference maps fixed (IoU 0.575, scale 0.050 pass, dE 34.8->13.3; Divine Eye objectness 0.657, reconstructionModeSuspected). Remaining: seat-box proportions too squat, lattice too coarse, turnaround loops still pierce the armrest top.
matched: open swivel ring with visible gap, column and stretchers
teak grain + braided rope maps load
back cushion rises above rear rail
mismatches: seat box too squat: lattice-cell counts (foreshortening-free) give lateral inner depth/height ~1.2 in the reference (11.5 x 9.5 cells) vs 1.62 in the model
perspective-corrected edge lengths agree (height/width ~0.83, height/depth ~0.83, rear-rail height/depth ~1.03)
aspect-ratio delta 0.134 is the same defect
lattice too coarse: reference ~11.5 diamonds along the lateral bottom rail vs ~7 in the model
rope turnaround Catmull-Rom loops still overshoot the 32 mm armrest and show as oval openings on the armrest top
ring diameter ~0.82 of the rear width in the reference, model ring too small relative to the new box
specFixes: armrest top 0.59/0.575->0.62/0.605, rear rail top 0.72->0.76, back cushion 0.48->0.50
lateral pitch 0.056->0.032, rear pitch 0.040->0.024, rope radius 0.0115->0.009, interlace 0.0075->0.006
turnaround as a flat two-point bridge hugging the panel edge (turn_out 0.006, embed 0.002) and drop mid-crossing stations

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout iter3: proportion fix confirmed (aspect-ratio delta 0.134 -> 0.009, dE 13.3 -> 11.0). Remaining: lateral lattice top edge is flat at the rear armrest height while the armrest slopes 15 mm down to the front and dips 12 mm mid-length, so turnaround bridges pierce the armrest top (4 oval openings per armrest); scale delta 0.145 is capture framing (compact model, fixed 1.45 margin), not model geometry.
matched: compact tall seat box: lateral inner depth/height now ~1.2 as counted in the reference
lattice density ~11.5 cells along the lateral bottom rail
soft boxed cushions, back cushion crown above the rail
open swivel ring with gap, column and stretchers
teak grain and braided rope maps
mismatches: turnaround bridges pierce the armrest top: lattice top corners use one height (rear armrest underside) but the armrest underside is 15 mm lower at the front and the profile dips 12 mm mid-length
capture framing leaves the smaller model at scale delta 0.145 (> 0.08) against the reference crop
IoU 0.564 remains bounded by see-through lattice holes vs a photograph (self_correction.md photo-vs-procedural caveat)
specFixes: lateral panel top corners follow the armrest underside at rear and front, lowered 14 mm below it to clear the mid-length dip
review capture margin re-fitted so the rendered bbox matches the reference crop scale

proceduralStrategy: Primitives + lathe + extrude for the teak frame; every member is solved from its two world endpoints so splay and recline joints meet.
Tapered-sweep zig-zag runs for the interlaced rope: one continuous run per direction per panel, +/- offset about the panel plane at each crossing.
Subdivided (Catmull-Clark) box cages for the cushions.
Generator gap: the InstancedMesh repetition emitter supports radial placement only, so the lattice is authored as tapered-sweep components.
animationAnchors: seat-deck pivot at the swivel axis: rotate about +Y to swivel the whole upper chair (frame, weave, cushions).
base-ring stays static on the floor.
destructionAnchors: Exploded view by actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup: base, frame, weave, cushions.
Per-component actionProfile.destruction.explodeVector gives the separation direction (meters) for the /capabilities scroll animation.
